section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: 6 Table II presents the number of accidental deaths during the last 7 years viz. 1964 to 1970. The incidence shows a consistently increasing trend, the total increasing from 95,478 deaths during 1964 to 1,39,752 during 1970. The survey of accidental deaths and suicides in the country was started from the year 1964 and the low incidence of accidental deaths during 1964 and 1965 may be due to incomplete statistics. This may also explain the very sharp increase from 1964 to 1966. But from 1966 to 1969 the trend has been fairly consistent and the volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population has been more or less about 24. During 1970, there has been a sharp increase of 6.9% in the total number and the volume also increased to 25.4.
